title: Rail Network Data API
description: RESTful API service providing real-time and historical data about rail network status, schedules, and performance metrics
purpose: Enable third-party developers and partners to integrate rail network data into their applications and services
serviceLevelAgreements: 99.9% uptime, sub-100ms response time, rate limits based on tier
capacity: 10,000 requests per minute, auto-scaling during peak periods
valueProposition: Accelerate integration development by 75% with standardized, reliable data access
performanceIndicators: API response time, uptime percentage, error rate, developer adoption

serviceFeatures.title: Real-time Train Locations
serviceFeatures.description: Live GPS coordinates and status updates for all trains in the network
serviceFeatures.purpose: Let partner applications show customers where trains are now

serviceFeatures.title: Predictive Delay Analytics
serviceFeatures.description: Machine learning-powered predictions for potential delays and disruptions
serviceFeatures.purpose: Warn partners of likely delays so they can adjust plans in advance
